hero.label: Compliance
hero.title: Built for Regulatory Clarity
hero.desc: CrossSecurities are designed from the ground up to meet securities regulations across multiple jurisdictions.

features.title: KYC/AML
features.text: Professional investor verification with tiered KYC levels. Identity verification, source of funds, and accreditation checks built into every offering.

features.title: Securities Exemptions
features.text: Offerings structured under recognized exemptions including Regulation D (US), Regulation S (offshore), and equivalent frameworks globally.

features.title: Multi-Jurisdiction
features.text: Legal opinions and compliance frameworks covering EU, UK, US, and emerging markets. Clear investor eligibility by jurisdiction. Wyoming DAO Series LLC legal structure.

features.title: Documentation
features.text: Standardized offering documents including private placement memorandum (PPM), subscription agreements, and risk disclosures reviewed by securities counsel.

info_blocks.title: Compliance Infrastructure
info_blocks.intro: Every CrossSecurities offering on Sails.to includes:
items: Investor Verification: Multi-level KYC with professional investor certification
Jurisdictional Controls: Automated geo-blocking and eligibility enforcement
Transfer Restrictions: Smart contract enforcement of holding periods and transfer rules
Reporting: Automated regulatory reporting and investor communications
Audit Trail: Complete transaction history for regulatory inquiries

cta.text: Our team can walk you through our compliance framework and how it applies to your specific situation.
